75294-history-as-literature-and-other-es.title: And Other Essays
75294-history-as-literature-and-other-es.creator: Theodore Roosevelt
75294-history-as-literature-and-other-es.description: A book by Theodore Roosevelt. treated as a branch of science rather than of literature. As with most such discussions, much of the matter in dispute has referred merely to terminology. Moreover, as regards part of the discussion, the minds of the contestants have not met, the propositions advanced by the two sides being neither mutually incompatible nor mutually relevant.

arxiv-2103-02973.title: The droplet-scaling versus replica symmetry breaking debate in spin glasses revisited
arxiv-2103-02973.creator: M. A. Moore
arxiv-2103-02973.description: Abstract Simulational studies of spin glasses in the last decade have focussed on the so-called replicon exponent α \alpha as a means of determining whether the low-temperature phase of spin glasses is described by the replica symmetry breaking picture of Parisi or by the droplet-scaling picture.

arxiv-2104-03379.title: Reexamining a Geometric Theory of Biological Growth
arxiv-2104-03379.creator: Dominic Gastaldo, David Silverstein
arxiv-2104-03379.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dominic Gastaldo, David Silverstein. A first principles approach to the theoretical description of the development of biological forms, from a fertilized egg to a functioning embryo, remains a central challenge to applied physics and theoretical biology. Rather than refer to principles of self-organization and non-equilibrium statistical mechanics to describe a developing embryo from its active cellular constituents, a purely geometric theory is constructed that references the properties of the ambient space that the embryo occupies.

arxiv-2208-03026.title: Inference of the sound speed and related properties of neutron stars
arxiv-2208-03026.creator: Len Brandes, Wolfram Weise, Norbert Kaiser
arxiv-2208-03026.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Len Brandes, Wolfram Weise, Norbert Kaiser. Information on the phase structure of strongly interacting matter at high baryon densities can be gained from observations of neutron stars and their detailed analysis. In the present work Bayesian inference methods are used to set constraints on the speed of sound in the interior of neutron stars, based on recent multi-messenger data in combination with limiting conditions from nuclear physics at low densities.

arxiv-2211-04230.title: On Multi-Robot Path Planning Based on Petri Net Models and LTL specifications
arxiv-2211-04230.creator: Sofia Hustiu, Cristian Mahulea, Marius Kloetzer, Jean-Jacques Lesage
arxiv-2211-04230.description: Abstract This work considers the path planning problem for a team of identical robots evolving in a known environment. The robots should satisfy a global specification given as a Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formula over a set of regions of interest.

arxiv-2212-05876.title: Fast nuclear-spin gates and electrons-nuclei entanglement of neutral atoms in weak magnetic fields
arxiv-2212-05876.creator: Xiao-Feng Shi
arxiv-2212-05876.description: Abstract We present fast Rydberg-mediated entanglement involving nuclear spins of divalent atoms with 171 Yb as an example. First, we show a nuclear-spin controlled phase gate of an arbitrary phase realizable either with two laser pulses when assisted by Stark shifts, or with three pulses.

arxiv-2305-15362.title: Production of Excited Doubly Heavy Baryons at the Super- Z Z Factory
arxiv-2305-15362.creator: Juan-Juan Niu 1,2, Jing-Bo Li 1, Huan-Yu Bi 3,4, Hong-Hao Ma 1,2
arxiv-2305-15362.description: Abstract In the framework of nonrelativistic QCD, the excited doubly heavy baryons are thoroughly studied via the channel e + ​ e − → ⟨ Q ​ Q ′ ⟩ ​ [ n ] → Ξ Q ​ Q ′ + Q ′ ¯ + Q ¯ e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow\langle QQ^{\prime}\rangle[n]\rightarrow\Xi_{QQ^{\prime}}+\bar{Q^{\prime}}+\bar{Q} , which takes place at the collision energy Z Z -pole.

arxiv-2307-11816.title: Gaussian state approximation of quantum many-body scars
arxiv-2307-11816.creator: Wouter Buijsman, Yevgeny Bar Lev
arxiv-2307-11816.description: Abstract Quantum many-body scars are atypical, highly nonthermal eigenstates embedded in a sea of thermal eigenstates that have been observed in, for example, kinetically constrained quantum many-body models. These special eigenstates are characterized by a bipartite entanglement entropy that scales as most logarithmically with the subsystem size.

arxiv-2405-19303.title: Morse theory for chromatic Delaunay triangulations
arxiv-2405-19303.creator: Abhinav Natarajan 1,*, Thomas Chaplin 1, Adam Brown 1, and Maria-Jose Jimenez 2,† 1 Mathematical Institute, University of Oxford, United Kingdom. 2 Universidad de Sevilla, Spain
arxiv-2405-19303.description: Abstract The chromatic alpha filtration is a generalization of the alpha filtration that can encode spatial relationships among classes of labelled point cloud data, and has applications in topological data analysis of multi-species data. In this paper we introduce the chromatic Delaunay–Čech and chromatic Delaunay–Rips filtrations, which are computationally favourable alternatives to the chromatic alpha filtration.

arxiv-2407-17552.title: Preliminary Evidence for Lensing-Induced Alignments of High-Redshift Galaxies in JWST-CEERS
arxiv-2407-17552.creator: Viraj Pandya, Abraham Loeb, Elizabeth J. McGrath, Guillermo Barro, Steven L. Finkelstein, Henry C. Ferguson, Norman A. Grogin, Jeyhan S. Kartaltepe, Anton M. Koekemoer, Casey Papovich, Nor Pirzkal, L. Y. Aaron Yung
arxiv-2407-17552.description: Abstract The majority of low-mass ( log 10 ⁡ M ∗ / M ⊙ = 9 − 10 \log_{10}M_{*}/M_{\odot}=9-10 ) galaxies at high redshift ( z > 1 z>1 ) appear elongated in projection. We use JWST-CEERS observations to explore the role of gravitational lensing in this puzzle.

arxiv-2408-03402.title: ULLME: A Unified Framework for Large Language Model Embeddings with Generation-Augmented Learning
arxiv-2408-03402.creator: Hieu Man, Nghia Trung Ngo, Franck Dernoncourt, Thien Huu Nguyen
arxiv-2408-03402.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) 1 1 1 The definition of LLMs is vague. Here, we use “LLMs” to refer to models with more than 1 billion parameters. Moreover, in the scope of this work, we focus on decoder-only LLMs. excel in various natural language processing tasks, but leveraging them for dense passage embedding remains challenging.

arxiv-2409-14771.title: OMPar : Automatic Parallelization with AI-Driven Source-to-Source Compilation
arxiv-2409-14771.creator: Tal Kadosh, Niranjan Hasabnis, Prema Soundararajan, Vy A. Vo, Mihai Capotă, Nesreen Ahmed, Yuval Pinter, Gal Oren
arxiv-2409-14771.description: Abstract . Manual parallelization of code remains a significant challenge due to the complexities of modern software systems and the widespread adoption of multi-core architectures. This paper introduces OMPar , an AI-driven tool designed to automate the parallelization of C/C++ code using OpenMP pragmas.

arxiv-2412-15589.title: Pre-training Graph Neural Networks on Molecules by Using Subgraph-Conditioned Graph Information Bottleneck
arxiv-2412-15589.creator: Van Thuy Hoang, O-Joun Lee
arxiv-2412-15589.description: Abstract This study aims to build a pre-trained Graph Neural Network (GNN) model on molecules without human annotations or prior knowledge. Although various attempts have been proposed to overcome limitations in acquiring labeled molecules, the previous pre-training methods still rely on semantic subgraphs, i.e., functional groups. Only focusing on the functional groups could overlook the graph-level distinctions.

arxiv-2502-20918.title: Dynamics of transport by helical edge states
arxiv-2502-20918.creator: Luis Alberto Razo López, Pierre Wulles, Geoffroy J. Aubry, Sergey E. Skipetrov, Fabrice Mortessagne
arxiv-2502-20918.description: Abstract Topologically nontrivial band structure of a material may give rise to special states that are confined to the material’s boundary and protected against disorder and scattering. Quantum spin Hall effect (QSHE) is a paradigmatic example of phenomenon in which such states appear in the presence of time-reversal symmetry in two dimensions.

arxiv-2503-14804.title: Using Lithium and Beryllium to Study Structure and Evolution of Rotating Stars
arxiv-2503-14804.creator: Wuming Yang, Haibo Yuan, Yaqian Wu, Shaolan Bi, Zhijia Tian
arxiv-2503-14804.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wuming Yang, Haibo Yuan, Yaqian Wu, Shaolan Bi, Zhijia Tian. The chemical composition of the Sun is still a highly controversial issue. No solar model has yet been able to simultaneously reproduce the solar lithium and beryllium abundances, along with helioseismic results, including the rotation profile. Lithium and beryllium are fragile elements that are highly sensitive to the physical conditions, as well as to transport and mixing processes within and below the convective zone (CZ).

arxiv-2510-08449.title: Hierarchical Spatial Algorithms for High-Resolution Image Quantization and Feature Extraction Thanks: Noor Islam S. Mohammad is a Graduate Student in Computer Science at New York University, Department of Computer Science and Engineering. Email: islam.m@itu.edu
arxiv-2510-08449.creator: Noor Islam S. Mohammad
arxiv-2510-08449.description: Abstract This study introduces a modular framework for spatial image processing, integrating grayscale quantization, color and brightness enhancement, image sharpening, bidirectional transformation pipelines, and geometric feature extraction. A stepwise intensity transformation quantizes grayscale images into eight discrete levels, producing a posterization effect that simplifies representation while preserving structural detail.

pmc-11493994.title: Losartan and enalapril maleate differently influence SARS-CoV-2-infected vero cells
pmc-11493994.creator: Julia H. Majolo, João I. B. Gonçalves, Renata P. Souza, Laura C. González, Nathalia Sperotto, Maiele D. Silveira, Sílvia D. Oliveira, Cristiano V. Bizarro, Pablo Machado, Luiz A. Basso, Ana P. D. Souza, Jarbas R. Oliveira, Carlos A. S. Ferreira
pmc-11493994.description: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has posed significant challenges to global healthcare systems, particularly impacting individuals with pre-existing conditions like hypertension. This study sought to assess the impact of the antihypertensive medications, losartan and enalapril maleate on SARS-CoV-2 infected cells. Vero E6 cells were infected and treated in vitro, evaluating cell viability via the MTT colorimetric assay.

pmc-11503509.title: Effects of screening coverage and screening quality assurance on cervical cancer mortality: Implication for integrated framework to monitor global implementation of cervical cancer screening programmes
pmc-11503509.creator: Minmin Wang, Hongda Chen, Martin C S Wong, Junjie Huang, Yinzi Jin, Zhi-Jie Zheng
pmc-11503509.description: BackgroundCervical cancer is a global health threat and a manifestation of inequality, and screening is an effective intervention. However, little is known about how screening coverage and quality assurance, influence cervical cancer mortality. We aimed to investigate the association between screening coverage, screening quality assurance and cervical cancer mortality among women from countries at different developmental levels.

pmc-11631347.title: Antibiotic resistance and molecular characterization of non-invasive clinical Haemophilus influenzae isolates in Germany 2019 and 2020
pmc-11631347.creator: Thiemo Frank, Esther Wohlfarth, Heike Claus, Manuel Krone, Thiên-Trí Lâm, Michael Kresken, Study Group ‘Antimicrobial Resistance’ of the Paul Ehrlich Society for Infection Therapy
pmc-11631347.description: Background Haemophilus influenzae (Hi) is known as a cause of invasive and non-invasive diseases. Especially ear, nose and throat (ENT) infections are common reasons for antibiotic prescriptions in outpatient settings in Germany. Therefore, antibiotic resistance surveillance is important to provide the basis of recommendations for the empirical usage of antibiotic agents.

pmc-12605079.title: Tricuspid vs Bicuspid Aortic Valve Endocarditis
pmc-12605079.creator: Geoffrey D Huntley, Juan A Quintero-Martinez, Edward El-Am, Zi Ye, Christopher G Scott, Christophe Tribouilloy, Maurice Enriquez-Sarano, Vuyisile T Nkomo, Daniel C DeSimone, Larry M Baddour, Hector G Michelena
pmc-12605079.description: BackgroundBicuspid aortic valve infective endocarditis (BAV-IE) patients exhibit more perivalvular complications as compared to tricuspid aortic valve (TAV) IE.ObjectivesWe examined symptom-to-diagnosis time in BAV-IE vs TAV-IE and its effect on outcomes.MethodsConsecutive adult patients (≥18 years) with native aortic valve IE were retrospectively reviewed from all Mayo Clinic US sites from 2015 to 2021.

pmc-13243137.title: COPD Patients with a High Exacerbation Risk: Baseline Data Analysis of a National Chinese Prospective Multi-Center Study of Quality Improvement Project
pmc-13243137.creator: Kai Yang, Dandan Chen, Yan Wang, Fengyan Wang, Lingwei Wang, Jing Wang, Tingfeng Yu, Huina Hou, Wei Liu, Peirong Huang, Hongying Yang, Rongchang Chen
pmc-13243137.description: PurposePatients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) with a history of frequent exacerbations have a high disease burden and poor progression, demanding optimized management. This study aimed to evaluate the real-world clinical situation, adherence to Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD) recommendations, and the associated factors.

pmc-13259615.title: Characterization of hereditary angioedema population in Argentina: A nationwide studyਮ
pmc-13259615.creator: Darío Josviak, Daniel Vázquez, Pablo Martínez, Iris Medina, Ricardo Zwiener, Alejandro Berardi, Gonzalo Chorzepa, Carina Luna, Vanessa Pussetto, Natalia Fili, Mónica Marocco, Gabriel Fueyo, Martina Indiveri, Florencia Baillieau, René Baillieau, Adriana Brandi, Marcela García, Gustavo Vijoditz, Matía
pmc-13259615.description: BackgroundData about hereditary angioedema (HAE) from Latin American countries are lacking. Our main objective was to characterize the epidemiology, clinical presentation, and treatment patterns of HAE patients from Argentina at a nationwide level.MethodsA non-interventional, observational, web-based survey was conducted, aimed at physicians treating patients with a confirmed diagnosis of HAE.
